verdict.rationale: Unleash Edge is a documented purpose-built component (Rust-based caching/relay layer) that sits between SDKs and the primary server, described explicitly as reducing read load and improving scalability/performance/resilience for connected SDKs, functioning as a low-latency edge/relay evaluation layer close to users. This directly matches the story, though evidence doesn't explicitly show deployment as a CDN/edge-worker runtime (e.g., Cloudflare Workers) itself. missing for 10: explicit CDN-worker (e.g., Cloudflare Workers) deployment guide, independent performance/latency benchmarks for Edge in production.
